Step 2 · Preprocessing
Data Cleaning Pipeline

A systematic 6-step pipeline was applied to transform raw, noisy data into a reliable analytical dataset.

Raw Rows
1,248
→
Duplicates Removed
−47
→
Outliers Removed
−88
→
Clean Rows
1,113
2-A

Type Coercion

Forced age column to numeric; injected string tokens ("unknown") converted to NaN.

15 bad values fixed
2-B

Duplicate Removal

Detected and dropped 47 exact-match duplicate rows using drop_duplicates().

47 rows removed
2-C

Type Parsing

purchase_date parsed to datetime; returned mapped to boolean.

2 columns fixed
2-D

Missing Value Imputation

Group-aware median imputation: age by gender, rating and purchase_amount by product category.

301 values imputed
2-E

Outlier Removal (IQR)

Upper fence = Q3 + 1.5×IQR = ₹7,751 applied to purchase_amount.

88 outliers removed
2-F

Feature Engineering

Created net_amount (post-discount), purchase_month, and age_group columns.

3 new features

Step 4 · Storytelling
Key Findings & Recommendations

Insights derived from the cleaned data that can drive business decisions.

📦
Sports Dominates Revenue
Sports & Electronics are the top-performing categories. Inventory and marketing budget should be weighted accordingly.
📚
Books — High Return Rate
Books show the highest return rate among categories. Consider improving product descriptions and preview features to reduce returns.
📅
Mid-Year Sales Spike
Revenue peaks mid-year (May–August). Seasonal promotions during Q3 can further amplify this trend.
🧑‍💼
Core Buyer Segment: 26–45
The 26–45 age band drives the highest purchase amounts. Targeting this segment with premium product recommendations could boost AOV.
🏙️
Mumbai & Delhi Lead
Top 2 cities by orders and revenue. Expanding fulfilment capacity in these hubs can improve delivery speed and satisfaction.
💸
Discount Effectiveness
20–25% discounts yield optimal net revenue balance. Discounts beyond 25% erode margin without significant volume gain.
⭐
Rating Skewed Positive
Average rating of 3.64 with a right-skewed distribution indicates most customers are satisfied, with room to convert 3-star buyers to 4+.
🔗
Discount & Rating Independent
Near-zero correlation between discount_pct and rating suggests customer satisfaction is driven by product quality, not pricing incentives.
